templates.name: Property management
templates.headline: A clearer view of every property.
templates.summary: Connect your portfolio, agreements, collections and maintenance in one operating foundation.
templates.limits: Statements, period closing, online payments and automated booking integrations still need extension.

templates.name: Real estate agency
templates.headline: Keep every inquiry moving.
templates.summary: Start with leads, shared contacts, property records and document coordination.
workflow: Keep property details and documents close
templates.limits: Public sales listings, buyer matching, viewings, commissions and sale closing are not yet dedicated workflows.

templates.name: Architecture firm
templates.headline: Bring client work into focus.
templates.summary: Connect client engagements, staff leads, actual time and business documents.
workflow: Assign a lead and record actual time
templates.limits: CAD collaboration, project milestones, quotations, signing and service invoices are planned.

templates.name: General contractor
templates.headline: Keep site work connected to the office.
templates.summary: Coordinate customer jobs, technician schedules, material quantities and site documents.
workflow: Keep stock records and documents accessible
templates.limits: Jobs do not automatically deduct stock. Quotes, procurement, project costing and progress billing are planned.

templates.name: Gardening & landscaping
templates.headline: Plan the next visit. Keep the work in view.
templates.summary: Connect customer site jobs, staff schedules and supply records for garden service operations.
templates.limits: Recurring visits, route optimization, job-linked materials, landscaping quotes and customer invoicing are planned.

templates.name: Property owner association
templates.headline: Keep your community records together.
templates.summary: Coordinate unit ownership, resident billing records, maintenance and documents.
templates.limits: Association mode must be enabled by the owner. Percentage cost allocation, voting and reserve-fund workflows are not implemented.

templates.name: Retail store
templates.headline: Keep products and stock in view.
templates.summary: Connect your store catalog, orders, receiving, retail balances and staff in one workspace.
workflow: Confirm orders and receive or fulfill
Approve payroll and coordinate store tasks
templates.limits: Internal documents only; no VAT/fiscal certification, supplier bill variances, statutory rate tables or online-store/payment-provider integration. Opening valuation and payroll rules require owner review.

templates.name: Restaurant or studio kitchen
templates.headline: Connect your menu to the kitchen.
templates.summary: Cashier-friendly Food POS with Pay Before Prep or Prep Before Pay, optional table tags, kitchen workflow, invoices and recipe costing.
workflow: Choose Pay Before Prep or Prep Before Pay, then take dine-in or takeaway orders
Track preparation; deduct recipe ingredients when preparation starts if Kitchen Inventory is enabled
templates.limits: Online customer ordering, tax configuration, reservations, printer integration, dedicated mobile apps and automatic stock-based menu availability remain planned. Actual recipe cost is estimated from configured ingredient costs; weighted-average Inventory valuation is not yet integrated into the calculator.

templates.name: Laundry shop
templates.headline: Price every load. Take payment at the counter.
templates.summary: Laundry intake, price list, mixed kg and piece tickets, counter collection and cash sessions on the shared services foundation.
workflow: Set up the laundry price list
Receive a load and generate bag codes
Price the ticket and collect payment
Progress production and release every bag
templates.limits: Counter price list, payment and receipt are included. SMS, rider delivery, garment tags, machine monitoring and offline mode remain planned.

templates.name: Professional services
templates.headline: Keep engagements and actual time together.
templates.summary: Client work with reviewed time records.
templates.limits: Service billing, payroll and project milestones are planned.

templates.name: Trades business
templates.headline: From request to completed site work.
templates.summary: Customer jobs and technician dispatch.
templates.limits: Quotes, material deduction and invoicing are planned.

templates.name: Gym, studio or pickleball venue
templates.headline: Health & Fitness Foundation
templates.summary: Choose Gym / Fitness for memberships and classes, or Pickleball for court reservations and open play.
workflow: Set up courts and avoid double-booking
Host open play with player limits
templates.limits: Online payment and accounting posting are not included. Court and open-play fees are tracking records. Tournaments are planned. No medical records are collected.

templates.name: Production business
templates.headline: Connect recipes to stock movements.
templates.summary: BOMs and full-quantity production orders.
templates.limits: Costing, partial production, scrap and production returns are planned.

templates.name: Specialized business
templates.headline: Give your coordination work a home.
templates.summary: Shared activities for emerging business workflows.
templates.limits: This is not a nonprofit accounting, specialized rental or custom application builder.

templates.name: Pure HRIS
templates.headline: People operations in one focused workspace.
templates.summary: Manage employee records, attendance, leave, payroll, payslips and HR documents without unrelated business operations.
workflow: Set up departments and employee records
Review attendance, leave and shift records
Record payouts and review employee payslips
templates.limits: Payroll uses the existing BizERP payroll and finance controls. HR records and employee documents use BizERP tenant storage and permissions.

templates.name: Daily rentals
templates.headline: Know what is out, when it is due and who has it.
templates.summary: Daily vehicle and equipment rentals with an availability-aware booking ledger.
workflow: Reserve a customer and date window
templates.limits: Bookings are operational commitments, not invoices or payments. Invoicing, deposit application and collections stay in existing finance workflows; no online channel or availability marketplace is connected.

templates.name: Grocery store

packageFamilies.description: Retail and SME business specializations using shared ERP foundations.

packageFamilies.name: Real estate packages

packageFamilies.name: Specialized operations packages
packageFamilies.description: Vertical packs for businesses outside the property and retail foundations.

specializations.name: Pure HRIS
specializations.counterAvailability: Employee records, attendance, leave, HR calendar, shifts, payroll review, payouts, remittances and payslips use the existing BizERP HRIS modules. Operations and sales blocks are not included.

specializations.name: Sari-sari store
specializations.counterAvailability: Sari-sari staples, tingi packaging, utang and suki rewards use the Retail register. Price history and cost/markup pricing are available; fiscal certification and offline cloud sync remain separate work.

specializations.name: Water Refilling
specializations.counterAvailability: Water checkout includes container custody and Delivery Fleet with independently reviewed collection evidence. Fleet does not automatically post money, stock or custody.

specializations.name: Boarding House
specializations.counterAvailability: Monthly lease collections are available. Unified boarding reception and collector reconciliation remain planned.

specializations.name: Salon / Barbershop
specializations.counterAvailability: Optional staff/seat appointments, a service catalog, personnel assignment, visit progress and commission tracking are available. Service billing remains separate; salon checkout, phase planning and payroll disbursement remain planned.

specializations.name: Food & Beverage
specializations.counterAvailability: Food counter POS supports Pay Before Prep and Prep Before Pay, optional table tags, dine-in/takeaway, kitchen statuses, Food invoices and manual tenders. Recipe ingredients deduct when preparation starts when Kitchen Inventory and a recipe are configured. Dedicated POS login, online ordering, printer integration, reservations and payment gateways remain planned.

specializations.name: Laundry
specializations.counterAvailability: Laundry counter supports a service price list, mixed kg/piece ticket lines, cash/GCash/Maya/card tenders, receipts, cash sessions and payment-gated bag release. SMS, rider delivery, garment tags and offline mode remain planned.

specializations.name: Auto Repair
specializations.counterAvailability: Jobs, billing and optional vehicle intake, work-authorization evidence, QC and operational release are available. Item-level authorizations, bay planning and specialist checkout remain planned.

specializations.name: Retail Store
specializations.counterAvailability: Retail checkout, the native Android retail app and optional order pick/pack/handover evidence are available. Payments remain manually confirmed; physical peripherals need validation.

specializations.name: Services & Contracting
specializations.counterAvailability: Quotes, work evidence, billing and optional staff/site visits are available. Unified reception checkout, variations and construction billing need further work.

specializations.name: Daily rentals
specializations.counterAvailability: Daily rentals use the availability-aware booking desk. Deposits are recorded on the booking; invoices, payments and deposit application stay in existing finance workflows.

specializations.name: Pharmacy
specializations.counterAvailability: Shared Retail counter with pharmacist-reviewed prescriptions, lot expiry and partial dispensing. Prescription uploads are placeholders. Controlled drugs are not supported.

specializations.name: Spa & Wellness
specializations.counterAvailability: Included Spa reception, assigned therapist worklists and owner-enabled cashier collection in the cloud.
